### Visual Layout Description  
- **Header**: A light blue horizontal bar at the top of the image contains the Arabic text "الإدخال" (centered, black font).  
- **Form Fields**: Below the header, there are 10 labeled input fields arranged vertically in a single column. Each field consists of a text label (left-aligned, black font) followed by a rectangular text box (white background, black border). All text boxes are empty.  
  - **Field 1**: Label "ID" (English) with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 2**: Label "(حقل نصي)" (Arabic, meaning "text field") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 3**: Label "اسم الطالب" (Arabic, "Student Name") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 4**: Label "المرحلة" (Arabic, "Level/Stage") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 5**: Label "القسم" (Arabic, "Department") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 6**: Label "الكلية (الجامعة)" (Arabic, "College (University)") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 7**: Label "الشعبة" (Arabic, "Section") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 8**: Label "النوع" (Arabic, "Type") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 9**: Label "البريد الإلكتروني" (Arabic, "Email") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 10**: Label "الرقم الجامعي" (Arabic, "University Number") with a text box to its right.  
  - **Field 11**: Label "ملاحظات" (Arabic, "Notes") with a larger rectangular text box (wider and taller than others) to its right.  
- **Background**: The form is set against a white background. No buttons, icons, or additional decorative elements are visible.  


### Field Status (Form)  
All fields are **empty** (no text entered in any text box).
